entities.name: Female genital tuberculosis
observations: Female genital tuberculosis can present with infertility, menstrual irregularity, abnormal uterine bleeding, and chronic pelvic discomfort.
Fallopian-tube involvement may cause peritubal adhesions, sinus-tract abnormalities, and impaired fertility.
